name: Triangle colors and palette favorites stay usable without recoloring existing pixels
description: Editing the foreground through the pinned triangle changes the next stroke color, while palette previews leave existing artwork intact and a favorite remains available after reload.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the local PixiBun Studio at a 1440 by 900 desktop viewport.
Draw a recognizable stroke with the initial Pen color.
Pin the color picker using Color in the Workspace row.
Choose a green hue on the outer ring.
Choose a saturated bright color inside the triangle.
Draw a separate stroke with the changed foreground color.
Open Browse palettes from the Palette inspector.
Verify Sweetie 16 remains in Favorites with its swatch preview and artist credit.
Verify the saved drawing contains the original stroke and a separately green stroke, with neither recolored by previewing or applying the palette.
